profile_md:
**Liverpool** shows qualifying provision in several distinct places rather than a single institution-wide scheme. Centrally, Careers and Employability runs extracurricular employer team challenges under Launchpad (the Big Events Challenge with Culture Liverpool, March 2026, a two-day challenge; and the annual Sustainable Innovation Challenge, 2026 brief with Manchester City FC and partner universities). Both are selective, short and not credit-bearing; the Sustainable Innovation Challenge is open across the University with priority for EQ+ students. A central 'Real-World Challenges in Curriculum' offer invites employers to embed projects in modules, but no list of participating modules is published.

The strongest curricular routes are programme-level: MATH390 (Mathematical Sciences, optional Year 3, groups on employer-set projects with employer input on reports and Q&A), Geography and Planning's client-based group modules (ENVS467 compulsory in MPlan/MCD with named council and charity clients; Environmental Planning and Management Project), a Management School HRM Consultancy Day (one day, Enterprise Mobility, BDO, Hilton, March 2025), and an EEE module with industry-panel pitches. The MBA consultancy route, MKIB306 and Project Partners involve real clients but group working is unresolved. Architecture's Huyton studio with Knowsley Council is a live client project but team structure is unclear.

Several candidates are historical (Peel Ports 2022, Life Sciences 2021) or weak (CS and engineering group projects with no documented clients; Law Clinic individual casework). Provision appears distributed across departments with no compulsory or institution-wide curricular scheme verified. Much evidence is undated; many routes lack 2025/26 confirmation.
gaps: Further departmental instances likely (engineering, computer science, medicine, dentistry, veterinary science, nursing/allied health, biosciences, chemistry, physics, music/arts, politics) were not searched in depth. Many module pages undated; legacy Grand Challenges page not surfaced in search. Group working unresolved for MBA, MKIB306, Project Partners and architecture studio. Partner types for several routes unspecified. No participation numbers published. 39 searches used.
